        $cfg_pattern = { 69 6d 61 67 65 5f 62 61 73 65 00 [1-10] 63 6f 6e 66 69 67 }
        $stager_url = /http[s]?://[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]+)?\/[a-z]{2,4}/

    condition:
        $x64_header at 0 and $cfg_pattern and #stager_url > 0
}
